blocks.zh: 區域供應鏈：巴西與美國
blocks.en: Regional Supply Chains: Brazil and the United States

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives of This Chapter

blocks.zh: 了解巴西ANVISA的GDP法規（RDC 430/2020）及SUS公共醫療配送體系的特殊需求
blocks.en: Understand Brazil's ANVISA GDP regulation (RDC 430/2020) and the particular needs of the SUS public healthcare distribution system

blocks.zh: 掌握美國DSCSA（藥品供應鏈安全法）的序列化與Track & Trace要求時間線
blocks.en: Grasp the serialization and Track & Trace timeline requirements of the US DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act)

blocks.zh: 理解美國專科藥局（Specialty Pharmacy）與郵購藥局的最後一哩配送挑戰
blocks.en: Understand the last mile distribution challenges of US Specialty Pharmacies and mail-order pharmacies

blocks.zh: 比較巴西與美國供應鏈在地理挑戰、監管架構和溫控要求上的異同
blocks.en: Compare the Brazilian and US supply chains in terms of geographic challenges, regulatory framework and temperature control requirements

blocks.en: Commentary: Brazil's Supply Chain Regulatory Framework

blocks.zh: 巴西雙軌供應體系
blocks.en: Brazil's Dual-Track Supply System

blocks.zh: SUS（統一醫療體系 / Sistema Único de Saúde）是巴西的公立醫療體系，覆蓋約 70% 的人口，藥品由政府統一採購，透過 CONASS（州衛生秘書委員會）和 CONASEMS（市衛生秘書委員會）向下配送至各州和市立醫療院所，最終到達患者。
blocks.en: SUS (Sistema Único de Saúde, the Unified Health System) is Brazil's public healthcare system, covering about 70% of the population. Medicines are procured centrally by the government and distributed downward through CONASS (National Council of State Health Secretaries) and CONASEMS (National Council of Municipal Health Secretariats) to state and municipal health facilities, and finally to patients.

blocks.zh: 私立系統則透過私人批發商（Primary Wholesaler → Secondary Wholesaler → 私立藥局/醫院）配送，以藥品保險給付和自費市場為主。
blocks.en: The private system distributes through private wholesalers (Primary Wholesaler → Secondary Wholesaler → private pharmacies/hospitals) and is driven mainly by insurance reimbursement and the out-of-pocket market.

blocks.zh: Figure 3.5-1🔍 中，綠色節點代表公立 SUS 供應鏈，紅色節點代表私立供應鏈。
blocks.en: In Figure 3.5-1🔍, green nodes represent the public SUS supply chain and red nodes represent the private supply chain.

blocks.zh: 地理挑戰：亞馬遜雨林地區的最後一哩
blocks.en: Geographic Challenge: The Last Mile in the Amazon Rainforest

blocks.zh: 巴西國土面積 851 萬平方公里（全球第五大），北部亞馬遜地區地廣人稀，基礎建設薄弱，對藥品配送造成極大挑戰：
blocks.en: Brazil covers 8.51 million km² (fifth largest in the world). The northern Amazon region is sparsely populated with weak infrastructure, which poses major challenges to medicine distribution:

blocks.zh: 交通方式：河運（boat）是許多社區唯一選項，部分偏遠村落僅能靠空運（small aircraft）
blocks.en: Transport modes: River transport (boat) is the only option for many communities, and some remote villages can be reached only by air (small aircraft)

blocks.zh: 溫度管控：熱帶氣候全年高溫高濕（年均 25–30°C，濕度 >80%），增加冷鏈維持難度
blocks.en: Temperature control: The tropical climate is hot and humid all year (annual average 25–30°C, humidity >80%), making it harder to maintain the cold chain

blocks.zh: 電力穩定性：偏遠地區電力供應不穩，冷藏設備停電風險高，UPS 或備用發電機必要性強
blocks.en: Power stability: Power supply in remote areas is unreliable and the risk of refrigeration equipment losing power is high, so a UPS or backup generator is strongly needed

blocks.zh: 物流分包：MAH 的物流服務商（LSP）往往需要再分包給當地小型運輸商，監管鏈斷層風險大
blocks.en: Logistics subcontracting: The MAH's logistics service provider (LSP) often has to subcontract to small local carriers, creating a high risk of breaks in the chain of oversight

blocks.zh: RDC 430/2020 的連帶責任條款（透過 RDC 234/2018）正是為了應對這種多層分包情況下的責任歸屬問題。
blocks.en: The joint liability provision of RDC 430/2020 (via RDC 234/2018) exists precisely to address the question of responsibility in such multi-tier subcontracting.

blocks.zh: AFE / AE 授權證明 — 巴西批發商許可制度
blocks.en: AFE / AE Authorizations: Brazil's Wholesaler Licensing System

blocks.zh: 在巴西，所有供應鏈參與者必須持有 ANVISA 核發的授權文件才能合法運作：
blocks.en: In Brazil, every participant in the supply chain must hold an authorization issued by ANVISA in order to operate legally:

blocks.zh: AFE（Autorização de Funcionamento de Empresa）：公司營運授權，由 ANVISA 聯邦層級核發，適用於製造商、進口商、主要批發商
blocks.en: AFE (Autorização de Funcionamento de Empresa): Company operating authorization, issued at federal level by ANVISA and applicable to manufacturers, importers and primary wholesalers

blocks.zh: AE（Autorização Especial）：特殊授權，適用於管制藥品（麻醉藥、精神科用藥）的批發商和藥局
blocks.en: AE (Autorização Especial): Special authorization, applicable to wholesalers and pharmacies handling controlled substances (narcotics, psychotropics)

blocks.zh: GDP 認證（RDC 430/2020）是取得/維持 AFE 的前提條件之一
blocks.en: GDP certification (RDC 430/2020) is one of the prerequisites for obtaining/maintaining the AFE

blocks.zh: RDC 430/2020 核心要求重點
blocks.en: Key Requirements of RDC 430/2020

blocks.zh: 溫度繪圖（Temperature Mapping）：配送路線需完成溫度繪圖，不限冷鏈藥品，常溫藥品同樣適用
blocks.en: Temperature mapping: Distribution routes must be temperature mapped, not only for cold chain products; ambient products are covered as well

blocks.zh: 運輸確效（Shipping Qualification）：所有藥品在運輸前需完成包裝/運輸方式的確效
blocks.en: Shipping qualification: The packaging/transport method must be qualified for all medicines before shipment

blocks.zh: 濕度監測：若容器密封系統提供充分保護，風險評估後可豁免；否則仍需監測
blocks.en: Humidity monitoring: May be waived after risk assessment if the container closure system provides adequate protection; otherwise monitoring is still required

blocks.zh: 偏差管理：溫濕度偏差需技術論證、數據支撐，並記錄於風險分析文件中
blocks.en: Deviation management: Temperature and humidity deviations require technical justification and supporting data, and must be recorded in the risk analysis documentation

blocks.zh: MAH 連帶責任：委外物流仍由 MAH 承擔最終責任（RDC 234/2018）
blocks.en: MAH joint liability: For outsourced logistics, the MAH remains ultimately responsible (RDC 234/2018)

blocks.zh: 中文解析：美國供應鏈特色
blocks.en: Commentary: Characteristics of the US Supply Chain

blocks.zh: 美國供應鏈的特殊角色
blocks.en: Special Roles in the US Supply Chain

blocks.zh: 美國藥品供應鏈複雜度極高，存在多個在其他市場罕見的獨特角色：
blocks.en: The US pharmaceutical supply chain is highly complex and includes several distinctive roles rarely seen in other markets:

blocks.zh: GPO（Group Purchasing Organization，聯合採購組織）：代表醫院、診所等多個醫療機構集體議價採購，提升採購效率，為美國特有機制
blocks.en: GPO (Group Purchasing Organization): Negotiates and purchases collectively on behalf of multiple healthcare organizations such as hospitals and clinics to improve purchasing efficiency; a mechanism unique to the US

blocks.zh: 340B Program：美國聯邦政府補貼計畫，允許符合資格的醫療機構（主要服務弱勢族群）以大幅折扣購買藥品，由製造商強制參與。340B 藥品不得轉售，追蹤管理複雜
blocks.en: 340B Program: A US federal subsidy program that allows eligible healthcare organizations (mainly serving vulnerable populations) to buy medicines at steep discounts, with mandatory manufacturer participation. 340B medicines may not be resold, and tracking them is complex

blocks.zh: Specialty Pharmacy（專科藥局）：專門處理高價、需特殊儲存/給藥或需要密集患者管理的藥品（如生物製劑、腫瘤藥、罕病用藥），往往需要 2–8°C 冷鏈直接到患者家門
blocks.en: Specialty Pharmacy: Handles high-cost medicines that need special storage/administration or intensive patient management (such as biologics, oncology drugs and rare disease drugs); these often require a 2–8°C cold chain direct to the patient's door

blocks.zh: Mail-Order Pharmacy（郵購藥局）：透過郵件/快遞配送慢性病用藥，最後一哩溫控管理挑戰最大
blocks.en: Mail-Order Pharmacy: Delivers chronic disease medicines by mail/courier; temperature control in the last mile is the greatest challenge

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 203 vs. 21 CFR 205 — 差異一覽
blocks.en: 21 CFR 203 vs. 21 CFR 205: Overview of Differences

blocks.zh: 兩者均未涵蓋溫控包裝及運輸的具體要求。美國溫控運輸規範主要依賴 USP <659> 與 <1079> 指引（非法律強制），此為美國體系與巴西 RDC 430/2020 的最大差異。
blocks.en: Neither regulation covers specific requirements for temperature-controlled packaging and transport. US temperature-controlled transport practice relies mainly on the USP <659> and <1079> guidance (not legally mandatory), which is the biggest difference between the US system and Brazil's RDC 430/2020.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：USP <659> 與 <1079> 實務意義
blocks.en: Commentary: Practical Significance of USP <659> and <1079>

blocks.zh: USP 章節定位：指引 vs. 法規
blocks.en: Status of USP Chapters: Guidance vs. Regulation

blocks.zh: USP 的 General Chapter 分兩大類：
blocks.en: USP General Chapters fall into two categories:

blocks.zh: 編號 <1000 的章節（如 <659>）：具有強制性（mandatory）——只要藥品在 USP 收載範圍內，必須符合
blocks.en: Chapters numbered <1000 (such as <659>): Mandatory. Any product within the scope of the USP monographs must comply

blocks.zh: 編號 ≥1000 的章節（如 <1079>）：僅為指引性（informational）——不具法律強制效力，但被監管機構和業界廣泛採納作為最佳實務標準
blocks.en: Chapters numbered ≥1000 (such as <1079>): Informational guidance only. They have no legal force but are widely adopted by regulators and industry as a best practice standard

blocks.zh: 因此 USP <1079> 雖非法規，卻是 FDA 查廠和行業標準的實際基準，GAP 存在時可能引發 FDA 483 觀察意見。
blocks.en: Therefore, although USP <1079> is not a regulation, it is the practical benchmark for FDA inspections and industry standards, and a gap against it may lead to an FDA Form 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 郵購藥局（Mail-Order Pharmacy）最後一哩：溫控灰色地帶
blocks.en: Mail-Order Pharmacy (Last Mile): A Gray Area for Temperature Control

blocks.zh: 美國郵購藥局占處方藥市場約 30%，其最後一哩面臨獨特挑戰：
blocks.en: Mail-order pharmacies account for about 30% of the US prescription drug market, and their last mile faces unique challenges:

blocks.zh: 包材選擇：通常使用常溫隔熱袋 + 冰袋（gel pack），可維持 2–8°C 24–72 小時
blocks.en: Packaging selection: Typically an ambient insulated mailer plus gel packs, which can maintain 2–8°C for 24–72 hours

blocks.zh: 暴露時間：包裹送達後若患者不在家，可能在信箱/門口暴露數小時，超出設計保護範圍
blocks.en: Exposure time: If the patient is not home when the package arrives, it may sit in the mailbox or at the door for hours, beyond the protection the packaging was designed to provide

blocks.zh: 責任歸屬爭議：製造商、批發商、郵購藥局、快遞公司，誰對溫度偏差負責？——美國目前無統一答案，USP <1079> 主張各方應有質量協議（Quality Agreement）明確規定
blocks.en: Disputed responsibility: Who is responsible for a temperature excursion: the manufacturer, wholesaler, mail-order pharmacy or courier? The US currently has no uniform answer; USP <1079> advocates that the parties have a Quality Agreement that clearly defines this

blocks.zh: 患者意識不足：患者常不了解需立即存入冰箱，FDA 已收到越來越多患者投訴
blocks.en: Limited patient awareness: Patients often do not realize the product must be refrigerated immediately, and the FDA has received a growing number of patient complaints

blocks.zh: 監管趨勢：Florida、Georgia、Oklahoma 等州已開始強化批發商/藥局的配送合規要求。
blocks.en: Regulatory trend: States such as Florida, Georgia and Oklahoma have begun to strengthen distribution compliance requirements for wholesalers/pharmacies.

blocks.zh: 中文解析：NABP 授權與州級監管
blocks.en: Commentary: NABP Accreditation and State-Level Regulation

blocks.zh: 重要：即使批發商沒有在某州設立實體倉庫，只要向該州的藥局/醫院配送，仍需持有該州的批發商許可。這意味著大型全國性批發商（如 McKesson、AmerisourceBergen、Cardinal Health）需同時維持 50 個州的許可。
blocks.en: Important: Even if a wholesaler has no physical warehouse in a given state, it still needs that state's wholesaler license as long as it distributes to pharmacies/hospitals in that state. This means large national wholesalers (such as McKesson, AmerisourceBergen and Cardinal Health) must maintain licenses in all 50 states at the same time.

blocks.zh: DSCSA 時間線：從立法到全鏈追溯
blocks.en: DSCSA Timeline: From Legislation to Full-Chain Traceability

blocks.zh: 注意：FDA 曾多次延長過渡期。2023 年的全鏈要求實際執法時間因業界準備度而延至 2024–2025 年逐步落實。
blocks.en: Note: The FDA has extended the transition period several times. Enforcement of the 2023 full-chain requirements was phased in gradually over 2024–2025, depending on industry readiness.

blocks.zh: 美國三大主要批發商（Big 3）
blocks.en: The Three Major US Wholesalers (Big 3)

blocks.zh: 美國 90% 以上的處方藥由三家公司主導批發配送：
blocks.en: More than 90% of US prescription drugs are distributed by three dominant wholesalers:

blocks.zh: McKesson Corporation — 市占率最高，約 33%
blocks.en: McKesson Corporation — Highest market share, about 33%

blocks.zh: AmerisourceBergen (ABC) — 現更名 Cencora，約 30%
blocks.en: AmerisourceBergen (ABC) — Now renamed Cencora, about 30%

blocks.zh: Cardinal Health — 約 25%
blocks.en: Cardinal Health — About 25%

blocks.zh: 這三家均持有 NABP 認證，並在各州持有批發商許可。其冷鏈基礎設施及 DSCSA EPCIS 系統的導入直接影響整個美國供應鏈的合規水準。
blocks.en: All three hold NABP accreditation and hold wholesaler licenses in each state. Their cold chain infrastructure and adoption of DSCSA EPCIS systems directly affect the compliance level of the entire US supply chain.

blocks.zh: 340B 計畫 — 為何對供應鏈管理複雜？
blocks.en: The 340B Program: Why Does It Complicate Supply Chain Management?

blocks.zh: 340B Program（由美國健康資源服務局 HRSA 監管）允許符合資格的機構（Covered Entity，如聯邦政府支持的社區健康中心、Ryan White HIV 診所、兒童醫院）以廠商規定的折扣價購買門診藥品。
blocks.en: The 340B Program (overseen by the Health Resources and Services Administration, HRSA) allows eligible organizations (Covered Entities, such as federally supported community health centers, Ryan White HIV clinics and children's hospitals) to buy outpatient drugs at manufacturer-specified discounted prices.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈複雜性來源：
blocks.en: Sources of supply chain complexity:

blocks.zh: 340B 藥品與一般商業藥品必須分開追蹤，不得混用（「drug diversion」問題）
blocks.en: 340B medicines and regular commercial medicines must be tracked separately and must not be mixed (the "drug diversion" issue)

blocks.zh: 機構可委外合約藥局（Contract Pharmacy）配藥，形成龐大的合約藥局網絡
blocks.en: Organizations may outsource dispensing to Contract Pharmacies, forming a large contract pharmacy network

blocks.zh: 製造商近年開始限制 340B 藥品只能配送至 Covered Entity 的自有藥局，引發法律爭訟（多家製造商 vs. HRSA）
blocks.en: In recent years manufacturers have begun to restrict 340B medicines to delivery only to the Covered Entity's own pharmacies, triggering legal disputes (several manufacturers vs. HRSA)

blocks.zh: DSCSA EPCIS 資料元素
blocks.en: DSCSA EPCIS Data Elements

blocks.zh: 依據 DSCSA 和 GS1 EPCIS 標準，每筆藥品交易（T3 = Transaction Information, Transaction History, Transaction Statement）必須包含：
blocks.en: Under the DSCSA and the GS1 EPCIS standard, every drug transaction (T3 = Transaction Information, Transaction History, Transaction Statement) must include:

blocks.zh:
SGTIN（Serialized Global Trade Item Number）
  = GS1 Company Prefix + Item Reference + Serial Number

交易必要欄位：
  - SGTIN              // 唯一包裝序列號
  - Lot Number         // 批號
  - Expiry Date        // 有效期限 (YYMMDD)
  - Product Name       // 藥品名稱
  - Strength / Form    // 劑型劑量
  - NDC                // 美國國家藥品代碼
  - Quantity           // 數量
  - Transaction Date   // 交易日期
  - Shipper / Receiver // 出貨方 / 收貨方（GLN）

EPCIS 事件類型：
  ObjectEvent          // 個別包裝狀態（commissioned/decommissioned）
  AggregationEvent     // 包裝聚合（案例 → 棧板）
  TransactionEvent     // 所有權轉移
blocks.en:
SGTIN (Serialized Global Trade Item Number)
  = GS1 Company Prefix + Item Reference + Serial Number

Required transaction fields:
  - SGTIN              // Unique package serial number
  - Lot Number         // Lot number
  - Expiry Date        // Expiration date (YYMMDD)
  - Product Name       // Drug name
  - Strength / Form    // Dosage form and strength
  - NDC                // US National Drug Code
  - Quantity           // Quantity
  - Transaction Date   // Transaction date
  - Shipper / Receiver // Sender / recipient (GLN)

EPCIS event types:
  ObjectEvent          // Status of individual packages (commissioned/decommissioned)
